entries.title: Psalms 126:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> When Jehovah turned the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

entries.title: Psalms 126:2
segments: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with rejoicing: then said they among the nations, Jehovah hath done great things for them.

entries.title: Psalms 126:3
segments: Jehovah hath done great things for us; [and] we are joyful.

entries.title: Psalms 126:4
segments: ¶Turn our captivity, O Jehovah, as the streams in the south.

entries.title: Psalms 126:5
segments: They that sow in tears shall reap with rejoicing:

entries.title: Psalms 126:6
segments: He goeth forth and weepeth, bearing seed for scattering; he cometh again with rejoicing, bearing his sheaves.
